d:
The Pelicans defeated the Hawks, 121-99 tonight in New Orleans. Saddiq Bey finished with a team-high 25 points along with 6 rebounds and 4 steals for the Pelicans, while Jeremiah Fears tallied 20 points, 7 assists and 5 rebounds in the game. CJ McCollum recorded 14 points, 2 rebounds and 2 assists. The Pelicans improve their record to 2-4 with the win, while the Hawks fall to 3-4 for the season.
